name: Innovative Leadership
body:
You blend your knowledge of performance arts with your leadership experience to keep your skills in the bardic arts and auras competitive.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd level in both bard (or legendary bard) and marshal classes, bardic performance, minor auras, and 4 skill ranks in Diplomacy, Knowledge (arcana), Perform (any), and Sense Motive.

Benefit: Your bard (or legendary bard) and marshal class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your total daily rounds of bardic performance and your total number of readied auras for the day. This does change your effective class levels for any other aspects.

You also stack your bard (or legendary bard) and marshal class levels together to determine your effective bard (or legendary bard) and marshal levels for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of bardic masterpieces (or bardic performances for legendary bard) and feats.
